recommendation: Require MFA for admin roles now; all users in v2, gated on a measured onboarding-friction budget.
dissent: devils-advocate: delaying user MFA leaves a known account-takeover path in production until v2 actually ships.
conditions: Admin MFA enforced before the next production deploy
v2 user MFA has an owner, date, and a kill criterion if onboarding conversion drops more than 5%
options_considered: MFA for admins now, all users in v2
